units.locator: Article 28.3. Officials authorised to draw up administrative offence records
units.text: 3. In addition to the cases provided for by part 2 of this Article, officials of federal executive authorities, their structural subdivisions and territorial bodies, and other state bodies licensing certain types of activity and monitoring compliance with the requirements and conditions provided for by a special permit (licence), may, within the competence of the relevant body, draw up records of the administrative offences provided for by parts 2, 3 and 4 of Article 14.1, Article 19.20 and part 1 of Article 20.8 of this Code.
units.label: Part 3 Art. 28.3

units.locator: Article 28.3. Officials authorised to draw up administrative offence records
units.text: In addition to the cases provided for by part 2 of this Article, officials of federal executive authorities, their structural subdivisions and territorial bodies, and other state bodies authorised to conduct proceedings in administrative offence cases in accordance with this Code may draw up records of the administrative offences provided for by Articles 17.7 and 17.9 of this Code.
units.label: Part 3 Art. 28.3 · “In addition to the cases provided for by part 2 of this…”

units.locator: Article 28.3. Officials authorised to draw up administrative offence records
units.text: In addition to the cases provided for by part 2 of this Article, officials of federal executive authorities, their structural subdivisions and territorial bodies, and other state bodies authorised to exercise state control (supervision) and state financial control may draw up records of the administrative offences provided for by Article 19.4.1, part 20.1 of Article 19.5 and part 1 of Article 19.26 of this Code.
units.label: Part 3 Art. 28.3 · “In addition to the cases provided for by part 2 of this…”

units.locator: Article 28.3. Officials authorised to draw up administrative offence records
units.text: Alongside the cases provided for by part 2 of this Article, officials of executive authorities of constituent entities of the Russian Federation may draw up records of the administrative offences provided for by part 1 of Article 14.1 of this Code, provided that the transfer of those powers is stipulated in agreements between federal executive authorities and executive authorities of constituent entities of the Russian Federation on transferring the exercise of part of their powers.
units.label: Part 3 Art. 28.3 · “Alongside the cases provided for by part 2 of this Article,…”

units.locator: Article 28.3. Officials authorised to draw up administrative offence records
units.text: In addition to the cases provided for by part 2 of this Article, the Chief State Housing Inspector of the Russian Federation may draw up records of the administrative offences provided for by Article 19.6.2 of this Code.
units.label: Part 3 Art. 28.3 · “In addition to the cases provided for by part 2 of this…”

units.locator: Article 28.3. Officials authorised to draw up administrative offence records
units.text: 4. The list of officials entitled to draw up administrative offence records in accordance with parts 1, 2, 3 and 6.2 of this Article shall be established, respectively, by authorised federal executive authorities, authorised executive authorities of constituent entities of the Russian Federation and the Bank of Russia, in accordance with the tasks and functions assigned to those bodies by federal legislation.
units.label: Part 4 Art. 28.3
